observed.south.png: A ground-coloured field. At the top there is an upright timber leaf with an X-brace and iron hinge, standing on the pit's upper edge, then a flat dark pit. On the lower bank are two small bollards; a rope runs straight down the front face of each post into an oval rope ring lying on the ground just in front of the post foot. The ring is squashed vertically to about 0.5. No bollards show on the upper bank: they are hidden behind the raised leaf, and no rope pokes out at the leaf's edges. Nothing lies over the pit.
observed.east.png: Seen from the side, the raised leaf is a thin vertical plank-edge with iron bands, standing at the left pit edge. Each bank has two bollards, and beside each bollard, on the pit side, an oval rope coil lies flat on the ground. These coils clearly show two concentric strands, an outer turn and an inner turn. The coils sit on the bank and stop short of the pit edge. No rope rises above the bollards.
observed.north.png: The leaf is drawn as a vertical planked board over the pit. On the upper bank are two bollards, each with a flat oval rope ring lying at its foot, touching the base. On the lower bank the rope runs down the post front into a flat oval ring just ahead of the post. The rings mostly read as a single hoop with a faint inner line. I cannot see a loose end clearly.
observed.scale.png: The lowered state, rotation E, for context: a timber deck spans the pit, with taut horizontal ropes from four bollards to the deck edges and a vanilla human at the right. Bollards and rope are small next to the human, which fits mooring posts.

CAMERA.seen: The coils are flat ellipses squashed to about 0.5 in the screen vertical, which suits a ring lying on the ground under the building camera. The bollards show their lit tops.

BORE.seen: No pipe or hose. The rope is solid and no open ends face the camera.

PORTS.seen: In the raised state the ropes are meant to be disconnected. Each coil is attached at its own bollard, either at the foot or by a rope down the post front, and never reaches the leaf.

PORTS_DRAWN.seen: Every visible bollard has exactly one coiled rope, on all four rotations. The upper-bank bollards in S are hidden behind the raised leaf, so their coils are hidden too. No extra connectors.

LAYERS.seen: In S the raised leaf hides the upper-bank bollards and coils completely, with nothing poking out at its edges. In N/S the rope drawn down the post front lies over the post, and the coil lies in front of the foot without crossing behind the post.

ROTATIONS.seen: The same bollard, rope colour and coil size appear in N, S, E and W. Coils on the deck-up bank use the rope-down-the-front variant, as the description says. The 67% height spread comes from the scene canvas sizes (tall N/S, wide E/W), not from the part.

SIGNATURE.seen: The ropes lie slack on the ground and no longer stand up, which is the key requirement. However, in N/S the coils still read mostly as one neat hoop with only a faint inner line and no clear loose end, while the description asks for about one and a half turns spiralling inward with a loose end. E/W do show two turns.

MATERIAL.seen: Tan twisted-strand texture reads as hemp rope; the bollards read as rusted iron/wood.

FOOTPRINT.seen: Each coil is roughly as wide as the bollard plus a bit, and stays on the bank cell next to its post. None go over the pit.

ALPHA.seen: No painted shadow, halo or ground patch under the coils. The background is the render's plain ground tile.

OURS.seen: The rope is cut from the bollard's own painted rope; this is the mod's own art.

OWNER_NOTES.seen: Slack and disconnected: the coils lie on the ground and nothing rises above the bollards or connects to the raised leaf. C6 true plane: the rings are foreshortened ellipses in the ground plane.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px/cell the coil is a small pale oval at each post foot, so slack rope on the ground still reads. The paired bollard and ring in S may look a little like a key, but that is minor.

observed.facings.png: Three offline renders on one shared scale: south, east and north. Each has a dark rectangular pit, the raised steel leaf standing at one bank, and small steel bollards with yellow-black hazard bands. The bollards have flat elliptical rope rings on the ground beside them. Canvases differ in size: S and N are tall, E is wide and short.
observed.south.png: The raised leaf is a tall riveted, cross-braced steel panel standing on the upper bank, hinged at the pit edge. No bollards or coils show on the upper bank; they are fully hidden behind the leaf, and nothing pokes out at its edges. On the lower bank, two bollards each have a flat double-turn rope ring on the ground directly in front of the post foot. The ring's far edge meets the post base and nothing passes behind the post. Zoomed in, there is a faint dark line down the post front, and the ring shows two concentric turns. A loose end is barely visible.
observed.east.png: The raised leaf appears in thin side profile at the left pit edge. Each bank has two bollards. On the left bank the coils lie on the ground to the pit side of each post; on the right bank they lie on the ground to the left, toward the pit. The rope leaves the bollard base into a flat ellipse with two visible turns. No coil overlaps the pit; the left-bank coils' right edge is about 14 px short of the pit. The rope is thin grey cable with a dark outline.
observed.north.png: The raised leaf is drawn lying over the pit as a riveted steel strip. Each bank has two bollards, each with a flat double-ring coil on the ground just below (in front of) the post foot. The coils are the same shape on both banks. No ring floats at head height, and no arc crosses behind or over a post.
observed.scale.png: Context render: the lowered bridge, rotation E, beside a vanilla colonist. The bollards are about a third of the colonist's height, and taut thin cables run from the bollard heads to the deck edge. The coiled rope in the raised renders looks as thin as this lowered cable.
observed.assembled_1.png: Same as north.png: rotation N raised, coils in front of the bollard feet on both banks.
observed.assembled_2.png: Same as south.png: rotation S raised, upper-bank bollards hidden behind the leaf, lower-bank coils on the ground in front of the post feet.
observed.assembled_3.png: Same as east.png: rotation E raised, the leaf in profile at the left edge, four bollards with coils lying flat on the pit side.
observed.assembled_4.png: Rotation W raised: mirror of E, with the leaf in profile at the right pit edge. The bollards and coils match E exactly, coils on the ground toward the pit and not over it.
observed.assembled_5.png: Context render: the lowered bridge, rotation N. Taut cables run from the bollard heads on each bank to the deck ends; the deck has hazard-striped edges.

FOOTPRINT.seen: Each coil stays within about a cell of its bollard on the bank and never crosses the pit edge.

ALPHA.seen: No halo, ground patch or painted shadow around the coils; the dirt shows through inside the rings.

OURS.seen: The coil is cut from the mod's own bollard rope art; no donor art.

OWNER_NOTES.seen: Slack and disconnected: the ropes lie coiled on the ground with no arch or hook standing above the bollards. Art brief C6 true perspective plane: the coils are flat ground-plane ellipses, and no bore shows.
